# Minsen Technology — Dehumidifier & Air Purifier OEM Manufacturer

> Minsen Home Appliance Factory (Guangdong Minsen Technology Co., Ltd.) is an 8,000m² OEM/ODM manufacturer in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. We design and produce dehumidifiers (20L–100L/day compressor, desiccant, commercial), air purifiers (HEPA H13/H14, CADR 200–700 m³/h), ice makers, fresh air ventilators, humidifiers, heaters, and air disinfection units. Certified CE, EMC (SGS), RoHS, ISO 14001. Founded 2015, exports to 20+ countries.

## OEM/ODM Services

- Custom branding, housing color, control panel, and packaging
- Flexible MOQ: from 500 units first order; repeat orders 50–100 units
- Sample lead time 7–15 days; mass production 25–40 days
- CE, RoHS, SASO, ERP, CCC, UL certifications available by target market
